Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.


We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.


We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.

Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results

4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Financial services marketing

You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.

new_jobs.description:
Position: Intern, Social Media

Location: Dumbo, Brooklyn (Hybrid: up to 4 days in office per week, based on your schedule and the team's needs)

Reporting to: Associate Director, Marketing

Program Dates: 12 weeks, immediate start

Hours: 20 hours hours per week

Compensation: $17 per hour



ABOUT THE COMPANY

Soko Glam is the leading destination for K-beauty, founded on the belief that skincare is a journey, not a quick fix. Through our curated selection of top Korean beauty products, educational content, and authentic community engagement, we empower people to believe there are only good (skin) days ahead. At Soko Glam, we're more than a beauty company—we're a passionate team on a mission to educate, inspire, and connect.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is your chance to dive into the world of social media within the beauty industry! As a Social Media Intern at Soko Glam, you'll play an integral role in supporting our day-to-day content creation, community engagement, and campaign execution across key platforms like Instagram and TikTok.


You'll collaborate closely with the marketing team to bring our brand voice to life online, while gaining valuable hands-on experience in content planning, social storytelling, and trendspotting. This role is ideal for someone creative, organized, and social media-savvy who's eager to build skills in digital marketing and brand communications.


The internship program will run for approximately 12 weeks. This is a paid, part-time internship with an hourly rate of $17 and an anticipated time commitment of approximately 20 hours per week (Monday-Friday). Interns based in the NY metro area will have the opportunity to work out of the NYC Headquarters (hybrid role, up to 4x per week in-office dependent on school schedule).





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Pitching, filming, and editing social content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Paid Ads, and other platforms
Promote current brand initiatives and promotional campaigns through engaging, on-brand social content that drives awareness and site traffic.
Monitor and engage with our social media community in a brand-aligned, timely, and thoughtful way
Pitch social trends and stay on the pulse of influencer content and competitive activity for weekly content ideation
Support content shoots and help organize visual assets
Track performance metrics and contribute to post-campaign reporting and insights
Support influencer marketing initiatives by researching and identifying relevant creators, building outreach lists, coordinating product seeding, and assisting with creator communications





QUALIFICATIONS


Able to work on-site at our Dumbo, Brooklyn office a few days per week
Strong written and visual communication skills
Deep familiarity with social platforms, especially TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
Proficiency in social content creation and editing
Confident on camera with strong storytelling skils
Creative thinker with a pulse on digital culture and emerging trends
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle multiple tasks
Proactive, collaborative, and excited to learn
Interest in K-beauty, skincare, and/or lifestyle brands is a plus
Comfortable using tools like Capcut, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite
